lines.text: Space... the final frontier.
Stardate four-one-one-five-three point seven,
Galaxy-class starship on a mission out past heaven,
N-C-C one-seven-oh-one-D,
Seven on the bridge, now we're making history!
I'm Jean-Luc Picard, from La Barre out in France,
Family grew grapes, but I gave the stars a glance,
Tug my tunic when I rise, call it the Picard Maneuver,
Gul Madred showed me five, but I'm a stubborn truth-pursuer:
THERE! ARE! FOUR! LIGHTS!
Tea. Earl Grey. Hot. And a facepalm for the fools,
Two fingers to the viewscreen, I don't break, I make the rules—
ENGAGE!
Make it so! (Make it so!)
Captain says the word and the whole ship goes!
Make it so! (Make it so!)
Out where no one's gone, where nobody knows,
Seven on the bridge and a thousand down below,
One voice, one ship... make it so!
William T. Riker, y'all can call me Number One,
Out of Valdez, Alaska, where the winters weigh a ton,
Three times they offered me a captain's chair,
Three times I said "Nah, I'm needed right here."
Swing my leg across the seat like I'm climbing on a horse,
Beard came in season two and it's glorious, of course,
But the Borg took my captain, put a cube upon the screen,
Locutus looked right through me, hardest call I've ever seen:
"Mister Worf..."
"...FIRE."
I am Data. Lieutenant Commander. Android. Positronic.
Built by Doctor Noonien Soong, my design is quite iconic.
I do not use contractions. It is not a choice. I cannot.
Yes, I am fully functional. A topic best forgotten.
Sherlock Holmes on the holodeck, the game is now afoot!
I composed an ode for Spot, and you will hear it, as you should:
"Felis catus is your taxonomic nomenclature,
An endothermic quadruped, carnivorous by nature."
I would trade a thousand years of perfect memory and speed
For a single human feeling... that is all I need.
I am Worf, son of Mogh! Hear my name and tremble!
First Klingon in Starfleet, and I do not dissemble.
Captain, they are hailing. I suggest we open fire.
Captain, they are cloaking. I suggest we open fire!
Every new villain throws me first, so you know that they are tough,
I get up off the deck, I have not had enough.
Prune juice? A warrior's drink!
Q put me in tights, made me Will Scarlet for a day,
"I am NOT a merry man!" And that is all I'll say.
Perhaps today IS a good day to die...
PREPARE FOR RAMMING SPEED!
Geordi La Forge, I'm the chief engineer,
Born blind, VISOR on, now I see the spectrum clear,
Inverse tachyon pulse, modulate the beam,
Every crisis on this ship ends in a technobabble scheme.
And if you doubt the engines got one more push to give...
You don't have to take my word for it!
Deanna Troi, ship's counselor, half Betazoid,
I feel every feeling that you're trying to avoid.
"Captain, I sense..." yeah, I say it a lot,
But when I sense you're lying, then you've already been caught.
Mother's Lwaxana, Daughter of the Fifth House,
Holder of the Sacred Chalice, and she's beaming to your house!
Chocolate's not a snack, it's a sacred art,
Imzadi, that's the word for the one who has my heart.
Took the helm one time, put the saucer in a hill,
I'm an empath, not a pilot, but we walked away still!
Beverly Crusher, I'm the doctor on this ship,
Tricorder in my hand and a hypospray on my hip,
They called me the Dancing Doctor, I taught the android to tap,
My son Wesley saves the ship and gets nothing back but—
SHUT UP, WESLEY!
Hey! Let him speak!
Got caught in a warp bubble, watched the whole crew disappear,
Asked the computer for the universe, the answer was clear:
"The universe is a spheroid region, seven-oh-five meters wide."
If there's nothing wrong with me... maybe something's wrong outside—
With the UNIVERSE!
Mon capitaine! Did you miss me? Don't lie,
Snap, you're in Sherwood! Snap, you're in the sky!
Put your species on trial back in episode one,
And the trial never ends, mon ami, it's just begun.
I introduced you to the Borg. You're welcome, by the way.
It's wondrous out there... but it's not for the timid. Ta-ta!
We are the Borg. (We are the Borg.)
Resistance is futile. (Futile. Futile.)
I am Locutus of Borg.
Captain! Captain! Come back to us!
The line must be drawn HERE!
This far... NO FURTHER!
Make it so! (Make it so!)
Captain says the word and the whole ship goes!
Make it so! (Make it so!)
Out where no one's gone, where nobody knows,
Picard! Riker! Data! Worf! Geordi! Troi! Crusher!
Seven on the bridge, one ship... make it so!
I should have done this a long time ago.
Five-card stud, nothing wild...
and the sky's the limit.

notes: All 98 lyric lines are sung once, in order: no skipped, repeated or reordered lines; the chorus is sung once plus the Final Chorus as written. Song is ~86 BPM (not 128): one lyric line per 4-beat bar. Instrumental stretches: 0-3.2s, 6.7-17.6s (after 'Space... the final frontier', before the Ensemble verse), 237.9-239.9s (before the Borg breakdown), 284.4s-end. Timing method: demucs vocals stem -> Whisper large-v3 (stable-ts) transcript -> fuzzy word alignment to the lyrics -> per-section forced alignment (stable-ts align) inside those windows -> onset/held-note snapping from the vocal energy. The full-song Whisper pass dropped 6.9-30.9s (Ensemble verse + 'I'm Jean-Luc Picard'), so that window comes from a second pass (see transcript.json 'pass'). Whisper heard these differently; most are likely mishearings, the starred ones might be real Suno rewordings: 8 'Gul Madred showed me five' ~ 'go Madrid show me fire'*; 10 'Tea. Earl Grey. Hot.' ~ 'T. Earl Greyhawk'; 17 'Seven on the bridge' ~ 'stepping on the bridge' (first chorus only); 20 'Valdez' ~ 'out as'; 24 'Beard came in' ~ 'Horse-bit came in'; 34 'an ode for Spot' ~ 'a note for Spartan'; 35 'Felis' ~ 'Selly's'; 39 'Mogh' ~ 'Moe'; 49 'RAMMING SPEED' ~ 'running speed'*; 64 'Took the helm' ~ 'Put the helm'*; 68 'Dancing Doctor' ~ 'Dancy Doctor'; 72 'caught in a warp bubble' ~ 'caught on the warp bubble'*; 74 'spheroid' ~ 'steroid'; 84 '(Futile. Futile.)' ~ 'through the fuel'; 85 'I am Locutus of Borg' ~ 'I am no cue to support' (vocoded, lowest confidence; timing from forced alignment). No extra sung text beyond the lyrics (the doubled 'goes' at 55.3s in the transcript is a Whisper artifact).
